Name: HA Deck
Description: Control Home Assistant from Ulanzi Deck keys and dials.

Actions.Name: HA Toggle
Actions.Tooltip: Toggle a Home Assistant entity and show its live state

Actions.Name: HA Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Control a value of a Home Assistant entity with a dial

Actions.Name: HA Dynamic Dial
Actions.Tooltip: Controls the entity of a long-pressed HA Toggle key

Actions.Name: HA Trigger
Actions.Tooltip: Activate a scene or script, or trigger an automation

Actions.Name: HA Sensor
Actions.Tooltip: Show the value of a Home Assistant sensor

Localization.pi.connection.heading: Home Assistant connection
Localization.pi.connection.tokenStored: Token saved – enter a new one to replace it
Localization.pi.connection.savedOffline: Saved. The plugin connects as soon as Home Assistant is reachable.
Localization.pi.connection.iconsUnavailable: Home Assistant icons are not available (HA 2024.2 or newer required). Built-in icons are used.
Localization.error.timeout: Home Assistant did not answer in time
Localization.error.internal: Internal error – see the plugin log

Localization.pi.label: Label
Localization.pi.icon.heading: Icon
Localization.pi.icon.name: Icon (mdi:…)
Localization.pi.icon.notFound: Icon not found – the Home Assistant icon is used.
Localization.pi.icon.hint: Leave empty to use the Home Assistant icon and colour.
Localization.pi.icon.hintService: Leave empty to keep the text layout.
Localization.pi.attribute.none: This entity has no value that can be controlled with a dial.
Localization.hint.noDynamicDial: No HA Dynamic Dial configured – assign one to a dial to edit with long press.
Localization.hint.oneDynamicDial: Use only one Dynamic Dial per device. If you add more, they all control the same value.
Localization.pi.dynamicDial.howTo: Long-press an HA Toggle key to control its value with this dial: brightness (lights), volume (media players), target temperature (thermostats), position (covers) or speed (fans).
Localization.pi.longPress.heading: Long press
Localization.pi.longPress.editHint: Hold the key, then turn the HA Dynamic Dial: brightness for lights, volume, temperature, position or fan speed. Entities without such a value are toggled.
Localization.pi.longPress.editValues.hint: Hold the key, then turn the HA Dynamic Dial to adjust the first value. With several values, pressing the Dynamic Dial jumps to the next one.
Localization.pi.service.name: Service
Localization.error.invalidJson: Data must be a JSON object, e.g. {"brightness_pct": 100}
Localization.pi.sensor.warnHint: The key turns orange when the value is above or below these limits.
Localization.error.noPlugin: The HA Deck plugin service is not responding. Restart Ulanzi Studio; if that does not help, reinstall the plugin and check the plugin log.
Localization.error.unsupportedPress: This press action does not fit the entity – choose another one in the settings.
Localization.error.invalidFavorite: The favourite value is missing or not a number.
Localization.error.invalidService: The service configuration is incomplete or the data is not valid JSON.
Localization.hint.noOtherValue: This entity has no other value to switch to.
